entry.title: HyperFold: Prover-Optimal Lattice Folding Schemes with Post-Quantum Soundness and $O(\log N)$ Verification
entry.summary:
Elliptic-curve folding schemes like Nova and HyperNova rely on discrete-log assumptions vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and incur heavy non-native field arithmetic when proving SHA-3 or Keccak circuits. We construct a ring-SIS lattice folding protocol over Goldilocks primes ($p = 2^{64} - 2^{32} + 1$) that achieves $128$-bit post-quantum security, $14\text{ KB}$ proof size, and $3.9\times$ faster RISC-V zkVM proving…

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #zkp #post-quantum #cryptography
